The top face features a prominent white circular logo with blue text reading 'eBooks' and a graphic of an open book over a red circle. The side of the puck shows vertical ridges typical of hockey pucks. There are strong specular highlights on the bottom edge, suggesting a glossy or wet surface beneath the puck.
